items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-01-09
items.q: What do you want to do, Tom?

ctx.x: I see the plate on it. They've been painted over as well.

Yeah, my glasses. It had the name on it somewhere right here. Yeah, it's a Lodrigal. Yeah, it's a Lodrigal. I've been snedling for years and years. All I do is now and then change heads on them. Yeah, the name on it's all right. You can't go by the heads. You can't go by the heads. You can't go by the heads. What do you want to do, Tom?
What do you want to do when you hit it? Yeah. No, I think the name would be right on here.
